info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Escalates-v2-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Escalation API enables organizations to efficiently retrieve information on support tickets that have been escalated for further attention. This API serves as a crucial resource for support teams, helping them to monitor and prioritize escalated cases based on urgency or complexity. Typical consumers include customer support representatives and team leaders seeking to enhance service levels and response times. By utilizing this API, teams can ensure that critical issues are addressed promptly, thereby improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of tickets that have been escalated for further investigation or action. Use this to monitor escalated issues and prioritize resolution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to escalate a ticket. It includes specific parameters necessary for processing the escalation.

ListSupportTicketsEscalatesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for escalating tickets via the operations endpoint.

status.description: Indicates whether the request was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number for the ticket escalation.

resultId.description: The identifier of the result associated with the ticket escalation.

state.description: The current state of the ticket after escalation.

processingTimeMs.description: The processing time taken for the escalation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context or information about the escalation.

audit.description: Auditing information related to the escalation process.

ListSupportTicketsEscalatesResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response for the successful escalation of tickets in operations.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the escalation process was automated.

Audit.description: Schema representing the audit details of the escalation process.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the total time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
